# @pulse-circle/web

> Browser analytics SDK for Pulse: a ~10 KB gzip, zero-dependency, offline-first
> event queue with idempotent delivery and identity. Sends events to
> https://api.pulse.pulsecircle.studio by default (no config needed).

## Install

    npm i @pulse-circle/web

    import { Pulse } from '@pulse-circle/web';
    Pulse.init('pk_your_api_key');   // publishable client key from your Pulse app
    Pulse.track('signup_completed', { plan: 'pro' });
    Pulse.identify('user_42');       // after login
    Pulse.reset();                   // on logout

Script tag (global `Pulse`):
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@pulse-circle/web/dist/pulse.iife.global.js"></script>

## API
- init(apiKey, options?) — options: endpoint, flushIntervalMs, debug
- track(event, properties?) — flat props, nested up to 2 levels
- identify(userId) — link anon id to a known user
- reset() — new anonymous id (logout)
- flush() — force-send now

## Notes
- Auto-captures nothing (no fingerprinting, no auto page views).
- Persists across reloads, retries with backoff, dedupes by idempotency key.
- First-visit UTM params attached automatically.
- Get an API key: create an app at https://app.pulse.pulsecircle.studio

Full docs: https://github.com/Pulse-Circle-Studio/pulse-sdk/blob/main/packages/web/README.md
